I usually end with some last words but today I wanted to have a bit of a talk about what's been going on the past few months right here on Steam. I feel that not saying anything would be unfair and I am not really one to keep things quiet when there's stuff to be said.

Steam as a platform for indies has always been something I have been grateful for. Steam's underlying mechanics are robust and very powerful. Updating games on steam is awesome and my general experience with the support from the Valve guys has always been solid.

However, I am pretty sure everyone by now kind of knows that the Steam of 2018 is not the Steam I started development of [b]STARDROP[/b] with in 2015. When I launched [b]STARDROP[/b] in Early Access on June 2017, things looked bright. I've done a lot on my end to try and promote the game outside of Steam and we even won something.

Recently it seems Valve has tweaked the way the store algorithm decides when/how/what to show on the storefront and it's been a slaughter for not just myself but a lot of other indie devs the past few months, sales wise. None of us are sure what entirely has changed, nor how, nor why. We don't know if these changes and the results of them are desired by Valve or not. What I myself can tell is that Early Access visibility has decreased a lot.

What this means in general is that I don't have the time to sit in Early Access that much longer. I am in a way forced to release the game as soon as possible. Luckily [b]STARDROP[/b] has always been in a pretty solid state in general and has never had too many game breaking bugs. I will now go into the polishing phase of the game's development. I will do my best to polish out the most annoying bugs. I will do my best to add in whatever smaller details I have planned. 

What I don't know yet is how much of the extra stuff I wanted to add will actually be implemented on release. There are things that will be added prior or after release but I am unsure how much extra I can do on top of that. I always wanted to make a bunch of side missions, and I still do, but I have to look towards the future as well. This game has always been a bit of a niche, simply because this game is not a gameplay centric experience. While the game means a ton to me, I will have to make sure that whatever I do next is able to reach a broader audience.

Looking back at the game's narrative and things like that, I believe there are some really cool opportunities to do something with what I've done in [b]STARDROP[/b] on a narrative level and translate that into a more action oriented project.

I will be taking a few steps back with this release and listen to the feedback. I'm going to play around with a new project I started a few days earlier. I will then go right back into finishing up [b]STARDROP[/b] as best I can and prepare for its full release. 

I can only hope that I have been able to entertain you guys well enough and that you may understand where I'm coming from. Whatever happens my goal still is to release a quality product. I might just not be able to do it to the extend that I would liked. Whatever happens, I am happy I at least made it to the ending, I still am planning to add a few more levels to the main ship to explore optionally with some narrative elements to further deepen the lore.

I'm sorry for this massive Wall-O-Text but I had to share my thoughts and plans.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/98dd222c72f4fbe95208f846b07bb138522d977f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Future[/h1]
So, yeah. As I mentioned before I will now go into polishing the rest of the game. I surely have not rushed production, not skimmed any of the overall quality, it does feel that it's time for me to move on once I feel the game is at a proper level of quality.

I also don't think I will make another game like this any time soon. As much as I loved making it, the sad truth is, for me at least, that games with actual mechanics and more action oriented overall do better. I also don't like to just make the same stuff over and over so there's a very good chance my next game will have more traditional gameplay. 

That said, I also LOVE telling stories so I will probably find some way to marry the two. Does this means I will never make a game like [b]STARDROP[/b]? Or maybe a sequel? Well, never say never. My time spent with the voice actors and the other team members have been amazing. I will remain in contact with pretty much most of them and if I can ever muster up a proper budget I will most certainly revisit the universe, one way or another.

I also still want to make some more side missions. I'm not sure how many, or how often, but it's a nice way to explore new ideas and new stories.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/c2bf794cbe0063d7fd93661d5e2c032ae40e64b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank You[/h1]
To each and every one of you that plunged into this Early Access title, never sure what to expect, if the game would ever be finished, and all the other uncertainties a title in development may bring, I am so incredibly thankful to have been allowed to make this game.

I'm proud of the Voice Actors, proud of Adam, the composer and I'm also very proud of our QA team who've done all they can to make sure bugs are caught before release or put onto the bug list.

For now I will take a tiny break before I finish the game.
Thank you all!!!

[b]Joure & Team V[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/03f9fc7c6f235e1464a8bfc5b31cd7e78552acb0.png[/img]

notes.title: STARDROP - Halloween Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/304d126d4f18144a0c411944df23d5e84f42e22c.png[/img]
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]
So, I wanted to do something fun this year for Halloween. I know it's a bit odd to have seasonal holiday events in a single-player game but I couldn't help it. I like this kind of stuff. So, I had some assets lying around that I used for Play with Gilbert (My other game) and figured I'd reuse some of them for Halloween. I also included a bunch of other stuff in this update, including story related ones, so read on!

[h1]It's Halloween In STARDROP![/h1]
I made sure that the Halloween stuff is only visible in areas of the game that don't take place within the main story. I won't spoil where exactly but Aryn's own spaceship is one area. The Halloween content will be available every year from Oct 21 until Oct 31. It's an automated feature so I won't have to fiddle with files or updates or anything. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/49453c386fff4f9350572f4bbcbbabaf8251b75d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Scenes[/h1]
I also added new scenes to the cargo bay aboard the SD-01 explaining in more detail how the network overload system works and just adding more purpose to that section of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/23ba77b9cb31eaa3fbfd15df36edbe35545e8a05.jpg[/img]

[h1]Chapter 4 Slightly Expanded[/h1]
I also added one very important new scene in the game, extending Chapter 4 just a little bit. It's not much but it is the actual ending I wanted to include but I had to rewrite and further polish that part. I also felt this was a nice little gesture during Halloween.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/c73df154101c6f60e425df3494e43491c0b1e356.jpg[/img]

[h1]Feed Me Meow![/h1]
People have been asking me about if they could interact with the kitten in the game. While not directly being able to interact with it. (Which is probably out of my scope) you're now able to feed him. Yeah, It's a he and his name is Rascal. :) There's also a new achievement added as well.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/93ee3831a33bbba628049009aba8130d0d1cc106.png[/img]

[h1]There You Go[/h1]
I hope you guys like this update, however small it is. I'm still working on the final chapter, still doing my best to fix smaller bugs before polishing the game before full release.

Again, thank you for all the kind words and I'll see you guys soon in the next update. :)

[b]Joure & Team V[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/03f9fc7c6f235e1464a8bfc5b31cd7e78552acb0.png[/img]

notes.title: STARDROP - German Localization Added & More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/e827014bb894e4a5d635aa90bd6892a8460284dd.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hello Everyone[/h1]
As I'm working towards the completion of the main story portion of the game (Chapter 4: Part Two) me and the team have started to bring back some localization features. A community member has even stepped up and has helped us translate the game to German.

But there's more to talk about which I will do right here in this post. Let's go!

[h1]Community Localization Files + Guide Available[/h1]
A number of people have offered to help translate the game into a different language and I decided that now is a good time to start localizing the game in an umber of languages.

We will cover Russian and Dutch internally and have received help from a community member to translate the game to German. And now anyone who wants to help can easily do so. I've written up a Community Localization Guide for anyone who wants to help. Links to the files, and other important info, guidelines, etc are all available in the guide which you can find in the link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1516876834
[b]Current Limitations:[/b] The game has graphical assets that are currently not set up to be translated into our pipeline. I am going to look into how I can set up a possible way of translating these. There are also a number of other objects in the game that are not set up yet. Luckily these should not impact anything of great importance regarding the game's narrative. Translating these will be attempted while we're in the polishing phase.

[h1]German Localization Now Available[/h1]
Thanks to our community member Markus and our own QA team member Mondrian, we are now able to roll out German localization for STARDROP. So a huge thanks to them! We are internally working on Russian localization and hopefully we'll be able to announce other languages in the future soon!

[h1]Content Creators Spotlight[/h1]
I also wanted to put a spotlight on some content creators out there that have played the game. I watch almost every let's play out there and always attempt to pop into streams. I had a blast watching them and I wanted to share some of them down below.

[b]Insipid Comments[/b]: This guy is one of my personal favorites. It took him quite some time to get through the game but I had so much fun joining him on his journey.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jppnqTzqiuA&index=18&list=PLBiiBHdmdjanmTxU9Av4Ail8bFSi7TXqs
[b]Mystic's Library[/b]: I approached Mystic myself after I found out about her and I'm glad I did. She has a lot of funny vocal outbursts and her reactions are so much fun to watch.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_v20n-mkNLA
[b]Rhexah[/b]: Another really funny content creator. His video is full of hilarious reactions and observations. I'm always thankful when someone is this enthusiastic about the game and yet another reason to give it my all.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f83U1SHB9ig
I will do more Content Creator spotlights in the future because I think they deserve the attention. There are more funny videos out there and I like to share these with you guys.

[h1]One Whole New Achievement[/h1]
That's right I added one new achievement which you can unlock at the very start of the game. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/b6760d7a64181470a3cb01c7841abe7a3777bbb0.png[/img]
On top of that I also attempted to fix another achievement (The Plot Thickens) which some people have reported as not working so that one should be working now, I hope. 

[h1]Screenshots[/h1]
I don't want to reveal too much about the new levels but I'm very happy with were their heading. I just wanted to show some of them off here without any context. I know it's a big tease but it'll be worth the wait!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/bdbd81b39aa5a74c837618082990fdf2bfbe9997.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/dfaa112c98b8414d330722229674bf335e222e5f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/7a751a619e6ad2c8bc1d5e07e8f93da579d81db4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/7cbbe62d5908fad5f07ee9709729a757daef5f75.jpg[/img]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
So, as always that's it for now. I'm not entirely sure when the next update will be, because I am very focused on finishing the next real content release and it requires my attention.

I wanted to also once again thank the community for all their support.So, please take care and I'll see you guys in the next update!

[b]Joure & Team V[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/03f9fc7c6f235e1464a8bfc5b31cd7e78552acb0.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: STARDROP - Content Update August
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/bc8f5f2f7ede06e9f15031c3d2e921b56276db65.png[/img]
[h1]Another Content Update[/h1]
Hi there, fellow operatives! I'm fairly certain a few of you guys have noticed the updates coming in from Steam and I wanted to address them in this new update.

Most of these are cosmetic. I went through pretty much every level and have populated them with more, smaller props to add more detail to these areas as well as making them feel lived in. I won't point them all out but I'll show a few that I believe to illustrate what I'm talking about best.

[h1]Performance Update[/h1]
An important topic I want to discus before going over the visual aspects is that I been able to optimize the game in an important factor. The game runs smooth on medium settings but now it will run smooth on high end epic as well.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/3bb553bbdbd06d8db2628359176ef2f1ade29056.jpg[/img]

On higher settings performance dips would occur when you would turn on the flash light for instance, or at certain areas where there's a lot of bright lights. This has been tweaked to a great extend and I am now able to run the game on max settings with a consistent 60 FPS. It'll dip down here and there to 50 but overall it seems to have greatly improved performance.

Please let me know if you guys experience the same increase in performance, so I know I did my job!

[h1]New Plant Life[/h1]
I always felt that the plants found in the game were not the quality I liked them to be but I couldn't find any proper replacements, until now. While I won't replace every single plant on board the STARDROP, I have replaced them where I think it counts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/5aa2642087bbcf818801629bd32712ae91e70b1d.jpg[/img]

Now, these new plants are replacing the old "alien" plants that I used previously and I think they look really cool. As with every asset pack I use, I modify them to suit what I need. Luckily I didn't have to go to any crazy lengths for these ones, but I did have to alter some textures and I believe it paid off.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/c553214f15dfca185c8a62d3588e8c70fb002ffb.jpg[/img]

You'll have to find out for yourself exactly where they can be found but that's the fun of having a game in Early Access. Finding the new cool stuff. They're not easy to miss either, so there's that.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/db1600d759fc7f694f70374707cc039511973df6.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Props[/h1]
As I mentioned I have populated areas with new and altered props. I have gone over some of the older, existing models and materials and customized them further. For instance the shelves on board the SD-01 were so empty as well as a bunch of areas on board the STARDROP itself.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/75b96edd6a82633e2c936050c3c27ae5728de5dc.jpg[/img]

While I'm not done with every level in the game at least for now it just makes things much more alive and fleshed out. Consider this a mini-polish.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/0899698df159d2360fe016e155d001e2b75c20dc.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Airlock (SD-01)[/h1]
I also completely remade the airlock of the SD-01. The old one was simply too outdated and I felt I could do better.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/69645243661dfdb260ad1ec77af323fe55d654dc.jpg[/img]

I won't show too much here, you'll just have to see it for yourself.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/a958005df2a5edcf7965c466c2029cb53ac8d9cf.jpg[/img]

[h1]New "Wait" System[/h1]
So, yeah, I implemented a new system that deals with certain scenes playing in places that players could skip accidentally. I know some of the scenes in the game tend to be a bit long-ish and some people would change level or walk into another area triggering another scene by accident. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/e18eade2e32796af88a1f8313504741f35f7222f.jpg[/img]

I blame myself for that because I chose to keep everything in-game. While I don't regret this decision, it's a very tough one to implement in a natural way. I've thought a lot about how to deal with this and I think I found a solution that, while slightly immersion breaking, it does its job and people should not be able to skip stuff anymore.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/459407bef1ce41624442fbd639f223d8cb87d210.jpg[/img]

This feature is only used in places where dialog is important enough for me to use it. I myself choose when and where this system kicks in so it's not automated. I don't want to annoy you guys every time someone says something.

Sometimes it locks an elevator button, while other times it locks and/or closes a door when a scene is playing out. After it's done, everything goes back to normal and you may continue on your journey.

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
This is the end of this update. I hope you guys like the new changes and I'm making proper progress on chapter 4 as well. I'll keep polishing old stuff here and there as I move forward and will make sure to post another update when it's relevant.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/3238a7916bc679cf0f542b50f0daa849df4e7fc5.jpg[/img]

For now take care and thank you all for the massive support!

[b]Joure & Team V[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/03f9fc7c6f235e1464a8bfc5b31cd7e78552acb0.png[/img]

notes.title: STARDROP - Chapter One Overhaul + New Demo
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/2c52f112d5b0fdfae9096111edc6f8b47cee4dcb.png[/img]

[h1]Chapter One Overhaul Released[/h1]
Originally I planned to overhaul the first chapter when the game went into the polishing phase but it just felt right to do it before that happened. It has been nagging at me for quite some time that the older levels just weren't up to the quality standards of the rest of the game. Chapter 3 is where I truly felt like I was coming into what I wanted STARDROP to be and while chapter 2 is not below that standard, it needs work. Chapter 1, while still barely holding up did not feel right anymore and I simply decided that enough was enough.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/f79208ea8a5caa25f75c2bc71624b23fbf93f8e4.jpg[/img]

So what can you expect from this overhaul? Well, every level from the original first chapter has been completely re-made from scratch. I kept a few designs choices that I liked and I also tried to retain some of the aesthetics but I mostly used new and higher quality assets while keeping as much of the original levels in tact.

STARDOCKS has changed a lot too. I wanted to try and keep the oval architecture style but I just didn't have the proper assets to re-create that. However, much of the layout is still there and ultimately I do believe the new changes are for the better.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/34d5be1c1f2c3edfdc144094f27888d76c31269b.jpg[/img]

This overhaul also gave me a good reason to re-think a few layouts and most importantly, I was able to create a much tighter narrative flow. The game's tutorial section has been revamped and is much more streamlined yet also a lot shorter. I believe the main game mechanics are easier to pick up and are better explained. I also properly introduce the object inspection feature.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/b395cb8ca307ce3f322ca55a4489af4cada1cddf.jpg[/img]

The tutorial section flows immediately into the main story. A number of dialogues had to be rewritten to make sense, which again gave mean opportunity to iron out some of the old dialog that didn't make much sense.

This is something I want to continue once I hit the polish phase. There are other dialogues in the game that would benefit from it now that the story is much better laid out. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/125e68afca7c5eaf0692044bb34ed1963502e350.jpg[/img]

I wanted to address the fact that I also recreated the SD-01 Cargo Bay. While nothing drastic has changed there gameplay wise, it felt disconnected from the rest of the SD-01 design. There's still some work to be done with it but for now it'll do.

I have play tested the new levels quite a lot but if anyone finds any bugs, please report them so I can take a look and fix them.

[h1]New STARDROP Demo Releassed[/h1]
The demo, as you might have guessed, has been updated as well. I have been thinking a lot about what to do with the old demo, which was starting to be really outdated and I feel that the new demo represents the game a whole lot better. So let's get into what has changed.

I removed the SRO side missions. While they were a fun little extra, they should only be accessible once the main story is resolved. I also want to polish them some more as they feel too outdated to be left in there.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/aee38cf30c1a17144b6a636bbdbf494f435dc7f5.jpg[/img]

Obviously chapter one's overhauled levels will be replacing the old ones in the demo.But, there's another problem I faced. The new version of chapter one is significantly shorter than the old one. So by removing the side missions and adding in the "new" chapter one it would mean even less content and that didn't sit with me.

I then remembered something long lost to the world of gaming. "Shareware". In the spirit of that I decided to add chapter two to the demo as well. Give players a proper chunk of narrative and gameplay to get a really good taste of what the game is like in its current state.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/7da988f53404dffeabf50d60714a03514eb5253e.jpg[/img]

While there's a bunch of stuff I want to address in chapter two before release I do feel that it still holds up well enough to get people invested. So I hope that I made the right decision by doing so. 

The only real risk I feel there might be with this move is that the main game might feel shorter because of this. Now I do believe that once the game is truly completed, it will make up for that. I have planned a proper optional side story when you're nearing the ending.  But as I said, this is in spirit of the older shareware releases of days gone by.

Very much like how the SD-01 opens up at the end of that chapter which then lends to a very small optional engine room section, I want to do something similar with the STARDROP. Only this time, there will be a meatier chunk of story involved that will add some more depth to the overall narrative but I will leave that for another day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/39e9137c96191a7103aabd26a610ee165d265f23.jpg[/img]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
As always I would like to part with some final words. Besides redoing these level I have also been making progress regarding new content. Chapter 4 part two is coming along and I am now at a one heck of an important part of the story. I can't wait to get it all done but as always, I need time to do it right.

I would also like to mention that I am not sure if older savegames will still work with all the changes I've made. If you experience some issues you might have to restart whatever chapter you're on from the chapter selection menu. It's an annoying part of being an Early Access game and I have yet to get confirmation that savegames actually don't work as intended but I wanted to make sure just in case.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/00bee71908473821c6b255c81e8ec5bbb6b09803.jpg[/img]

I really hope you guys like the new content but if you've been waiting for a reason to replay the game I would say, yeah sure it's a good enough reason but I would probably suggest to wait until after polishing is over to really get the most out of replaying it.

So, yeah, that's it for now. Thank you all for supporting and helping me out. Take care and let me know what you guys think of the new stuff. :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/eb87542151aa1456a1b6103d09c54cf5f676810c.jpg[/img]
Take care and have fun!
[b]Joure & Team V[/b]

notes.title: STARDROP - Times Are Changing
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/6e8fbc3fcf9f68d8cd196f396d76085d59587bb9.png[/img]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
A lot of what I believe makes a game better is iteration. One of the scary things of being in Early Access, for me, is wondering how people like what you done so far but maybe even more so, when you go back and change things.

Suddenly what was familiar is not there anymore. You might have really grown fond of a certain area in a game and you find that it's gone... As I look back at some of the earlier parts of the game I wish I've done things differently. I wish I had the assets I have now or that I had the knowledge I have today. But I'm not going to let that deter me from going back and re-create some of those earlier levels. 

[h1]MCCV-2 Redesign - First Look[/h1]
Today I want to show you guys the new version of Aryn and John's ship, the MCCV-2. Mainly the new interior. I went for a more industrial look. I think the old design had this going on but in a much lesser capacity. Lighting has been another issue as well, it just didn't feel right before, compared to as it is right now.

One of the most important changes besides the visual changes is how the game's narrative will flow from here on out. I've done away with the entire wall panel puzzle. The engine room / cargo bay is gone. (At least for now, I'm not sure if I'll bring it back yet.)

It doesn't offer much in terms of story progression as it just feels like filler. And while this section was supposed to be a small tutorial it was simply too lengthy. I am currently rewriting all of the scenes but don't worry, most of the dialog will be kept in tact. Some of the jokes will return but in context with how the new narrative will flow.

This means that this section of the story will be a lot shorter. I don't care about milking game time at all because to me what's important is the actual story itself and it just felt too long for the actual main story events to start unfolding. I hope this change will address that issue and make playing the game a lot more fun.

I am also going to remove the secondary scanner function as it feels worthless. I've been trying to figure out a use for it in the game but whatever I came up with didn't feel fun at all, so it'll be gone once the new levels are out.

I'm not sure when it'll be released but I don't think it'll be that long. Some users have been kind enough to report some bugs in the new chapter and these will be fixed soon too. Now with all that said, I'll go over some of the new sections of the redesigned interiors.

[h1]Aryn's Room[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/25f61192cfd688b0179b58f3c17364637be6d90f.png[/img]

Aryn's old room design, and John's for that matter,has been bothering me for a very long time, simply because it felt too narrow. Too small. I also grew tired of the assets I used there. At the time I just didn't have the wide variety I have at my disposal now, so it's been nagging at me steadily and with the release of chapter 4 part one I felt that it was time to go back and just overhaul the entire MCCV-2.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/d31bb19bca7e8b3a064f0e7bb318b95bb6355d02.png[/img]

As you can see it's much more spacious. I also think the new visual look resembles an actual room much more than the old one. I also been able to add more props to it and place objects much more effectively with a lot more sense to their placements.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/8796cff56d0b709f7d2a582719bc4be52905cc9f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/56be15fa34a4fed240a984df6e7cf1c85d8d2564.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/94e8541f10a49f58897d27a56a77545fa9e29d95.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/481d933a5296f369afc80e1c19f114d5234dfeef.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/1033eebf091112e64362aba6669228397196dea6.png[/img]

[h1]The Galley[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/0ced14da168c160df919bd929689046c18f1e069.png[/img]

The Galley was a bit of a challenge. I wanted to retain the feel of the old one but the assets I used were simply not the same quality of assets I've been using ever since chapter two.

I also wanted to create a more spacious room and I decided to also add windows. I feel there's still room for improvement here, and I plan to see what else I can add to it but for now, it serves its purpose I think.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/fc4f99d39e76431a4750ae77b40d973f07282460.png[/img]

[h1]Hallways + Kitchen[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/a5daad1b883213445261ce025b4114c141553742.png[/img]

The new hallways, I believe, look so much more interesting. Lots more details and the overall layout of the ship has been designed to "flow" a lot better. I know I keep using the word "flow" a lot but it really best describes the biggest drive behind all these changes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/2cef26edded463f2430fdb6f317f1c6b8e2c6bf1.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/e096c36796b9184378eb24a10ab1638fd522c718.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/9a9f609cd3ec4c8a14efa05e34804fb42cc535fb.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/bc4edb913ef5ff22ffa52abd49dde4e36928b1cb.png[/img]

I also added a kitchen area, which I also believe can do with a little more work. There's not much to do here but it just adds to the overall feel of the new interior. Assets in this regard are tough because I don't have anything that really looks very Sci-Fi but I think it works well enough.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/fb33a279a48cbc4178dc4186ffc0292f7e90a767.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/6e64a768d5883c4261835eb6c2009ffa84547f72.png[/img]

[h1]APD Suit Station[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/eed991df0de668c511c0cf7aca48a3c93e6c7431.png[/img]

The APD Suit Station is now located on this deck. Again making the flow of the narrative much tighter. I think it also looks a whole lot better too.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/39a0023652122f8d78b528c3adec0009a15143c3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/a92fd04b75f42d445338326bf1f38fe0a8e27e0e.png[/img]

[h1]Bridge + Cockpit[/h1]
A lot of work went into designing the new bridge. As before, it was important for me to keep the old 'feel" of the area in tact as much as possible while doing away with things that simply didn't make much sense.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/e66441a9bff0d738adf84b147bc56078d0872f42.png[/img]

I removed the non-functional computer terminal. It never had a purpose so that was a no-brainer. On top of that I felt the old "Hologram Table" was done in a way that made it look like a hack-job, which it was.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/132644579de9185079be3fb1375f8c8dcf4a5620.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/d6d78904d149071575ea920150addecd7f5d8cf4.png[/img]

As you can see, the new version looks A LOT more like an actual Hologram. Besides the table I also upgraded the actual visuals and effects of the hologram itself. There's no real purpose to it but I always liked having it so I brought it back.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/09846ac4b93d8eb6d8f3d21de6e74669ac19d864.png[/img]

The save station is still there as well. So don't worry about that. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/74d6f3d3d4ee612c23aa45022a1bcc2eea8fbe8b.png[/img]

The cockpit was also in need of a proper update. I think the new one looks the part so much better. John has a lot more small devices and stuff like that for him to play around with. While it's all aesthetic it adds to the feel of what a cockpit should look like, I think.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/799593cb773784df7ee9b314a5f1a7b179be1a3d.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/4ae16ec641f06b2f2c0604bc5c02b48a73319d23.png[/img]

Lastly, I also made sure the window is a lot larger now. Making it much easier to view the SD-01 as John and Aryn check it out.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/d22652f301ae589768c0ade83e37260c23507cbf.png[/img]

[h1]Back Side[/h1]
The back side of the ship has undergone an upgrade as well. There's an actual purpose to it but you'll have to figure out what that is once the new levels are released. John's room has been always accessible but I don't think many people figured out how to unlock his door. The new design of the ship, and other information that is being presented, should make this so much easier.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/8a1157aead761716cdd72dc49f2a3b98461e4fc2.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/96adacc9764e97b42c0cbbd059932b3940d7e2f0.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/3f92d3fee7de51c4ac2c0d14fefcad8a2fb55c97.png[/img]

[h1]Not Done[/h1]
I'm not done of course. The Airlock needs to be redesigned as well. Deck 2 will be a whole lot smaller, which should also help optimizing that part of the game. Once I'm done I'll make sure to show that off as well and hopefully be able to release it along the same time, or very shortly after.

I hope this post was interesting and I can't wait to finish and release it. There are still other areas I want to take a good look at. Finix Operations office is another area I feel can be greatly improved but not sure how to go about it yet but I'll wait for that when I get into the polish phase. 

There'll be a lot of things that needs attention. The Cargo Bay on board the SD-01 can be improved. I need to address some of the scenes in there as well that needs to be rewritten, etc.

So till then I wish you all a very good day and keep an eye out for when the new update goes live.

Take care and have fun!
[b]Joure & Team V[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/03f9fc7c6f235e1464a8bfc5b31cd7e78552acb0.png[/img]

notes.title: STARDROP - Chapter 4: Part One Released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/a62e9f5c366d9f5c629df80df59355dce31956d3.png[/img]
[h1]Hi Everyone[/h1]
I'm really stoked to announce that I've been able to get Chapter 4 Part One to a releasable state. I want to make a few things clear though.

Not all the scenes are fully fleshed out. All the important aspects are in there and you won't miss out on anything important. I just feel some of the dialogues can be written better and I already have done so and am waiting for the new recordings. So don't worry, just wanted to make that clear. Other than that the dialogues that are in the game are not below any standards set to what's done prior already, I just want to make this part of the game exceptional and I strife to do so.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/43c70c166cb1122a3a96b929a9004fa5c491e7b6.jpg[/img]

I also wanted to note that Part One is not as long as a full chapter, like chapter 3 for instance. I also made sure that this is the shorter part of what chapter 4 should be in terms of length when it's finished. I had to find a proper end point and I think it ends on a very interesting note. I have already started work on the rest of the chapter and I feel it should cap the entire story off properly.

With that said I hope you guys will enjoy what's been done. Chapter 4 has been the most difficult one so far for a number of reasons. I want to be able to get the most out of it's narrative. When, where and how certain plot reveals are handled is very daunting and not easy. While the story has already been completed I always think of ways to do it better and I do hope I found the best way to do so.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/28ee3432199cdeadb918de20999550fe7700dbcf.jpg[/img]

The end portion of Part One was something I came up with on the go while I was laying out the story arch. I've put a lot of thought into how to try and execute it. It's something I've never done before, well this entire game is but I think it adds a lot of layers to the story and characters.

Obviously I will polish this part of the game along with the rest once I get Part Two out. I can't give a definitive timeline for when I'll be able to but as I've said so many times, I want to do it right. All I can hope for is that it's enough for you guys to keep your investment in the story high and looking forward to it's conclusion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/54b6e6b8aecb66ac684c06fe5bbdbb2e61b9d830.jpg[/img]

[h1]Possible Bugs And Other Issues[/h1]
I would very much appreciate it, if you guys could report any serious issues that you run into. While I've been doing my very best to keep the quality to a high standard (regarding Early Access) there might be some issues that I may have overlooked. We have been play testing the new chapter a lot but tinkering with some of the existing game mechanics might have introduced one or two bugs. So far I have found a few and they should have been fixed but I'm always anxious when putting out new content like this. 

The chapter selection should also work properly. I've tested that myself and have not found any issues on my end. 

So if you find any bugs or major issues, please report over at the bug report forums and I will add it to the list. While I'll continue to work on the rest of chapter 4, expect smaller updates whenever I fix a bug and polish some of the content and tweaking correcting scenes and dialogues.

[h1]We Need A Play Tester[/h1]
That's right. We're in need of a new play tester to join the team. Now that I'm getting so close to finishing the game I could use a bit more help. I would love it if someone has the time and experience to volunteer. 

Play Testing is an incredibly tedious job. It's part of what I have to do as well. Finding bugs and then trying to reproduce them, trying to figure out what's causing them. It's very taxing at times. Anyone who has the time and mental capability is welcome to try out.

You can do so here; [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/552880/discussions/1/1726450077685583504/]in this thread[/url].

[h1]Our Steam Developer Page[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TeamV][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/2b0356330e480abe9cc3d86a9884f47ec0210a3b.png[/img][/url]
I've mentioned this in our previous update but I wanted to keep this information a bit relevant. 

So, Steam rolled out a new update where us developers finally have a place to show our games. Besides STARDROP I also made/released a small kids game (I made for my daughter) and it's on there as well. I would suggest to go check it out and give it a follow if you want to be updated on future releases, etc.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TeamV]Team V Developer Page[/url]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
Please, let me and the rest of the team know what you think of the new chapter so far. I'm eager to hear what you guys liked and disliked. I can't wait to share the final part of the story with you all as soon as I'm able to.

I'm getting there, slow and steady! Yet, it's been a scary ride to have been working on the game. So many problems have popped up along the way, both with the game as in my real life and it's been a true fight for survival at some points. However, I stay optimistic! 

I love the interaction with this community where things feel a lot more personal than what I've experienced in other communities on Steam. So, thank you for that! I appreciate it.

Whatever the game will be when it's done, I'm glad I got to experience it all. Now stop reading and play the game. (I hope this post was long enough for your updates to download :P )

Take care and have fun!
[b]Joure & Team V[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/03f9fc7c6f235e1464a8bfc5b31cd7e78552acb0.png[/img]

notes.title: STARDROP - Update June 23, 2018
notes.content:
[h1]These Are Not The Updates You're Looking For[/h1]
Hi everyone. Today I updated the game. While this might seem like a pretty hefty one, it's not. Well, not completely.

A bug was discovered where the little kitten I added some time back is capable of blocking the player (I forgot to add an avoidance mechanic). I don't want others to run into it so I decided to take a middle road. 

I didn't want to just add a small update like that, in fact there are a number of smaller updates and tweaks also included but there is one other thing I hope you guys might appreciate. Read on!

[h1]Chapter 4 - Level One Released[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/bda760e78df38569eb85035ca02515601b71d807.jpg[/img]
That's right. For those who have been patiently waiting there's a new fully narrated level playable in the game. This level kicks off chapter 4 and sets up the rest of the story. 

I am still hard at work getting the rest of the scenes done but I just had to release something with this update. It's a gesture on my end to show more is indeed coming very soon. I know that it's very, very short but I really wanted to offer something to keep you guys entertained and actually show something tangible. Despite it being only one new level and not chapter 4 part one I'm working on trying to ship that within a week or two.  

That said, I have set things up that you will be able to load up the game once the full update is out and you'll be able to continue exactly where the game cuts you off.

I also set up the chapter selection so that should also be working properly for this update adding the new chapter.

[h1]Aryn's Apartment Updated[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/41f8b3eab9cf64fb16f34dadb8da47283907f9e0.jpg[/img]
While I was waiting for the new recordings from the VA's I took a little bit of time to update Aryn's apartment. It was just so bland and boring and it didn't feel right. I added more color to the scene, through lighting and objects.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/004a57afdcb68a9827ae273270576a96513c8e27.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/8e34e8343c8a18188cc43f3b6eb0869513d8d4b3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Small Tweaks And Fixes[/h1]
I also added some small tweaks in order to further optimize certain elements/mechanics within the game. It's not going to boost any graphical performance but it should matter in other meaningful places.

[h1]Our Steam Developer Page[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TeamV][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/2b0356330e480abe9cc3d86a9884f47ec0210a3b.png[/img][/url]
Steam rolled out a new update where us developers finally have a place to show our games. Besides STARDROP I also made/released a small kids game (I made for my daughter) and it's on there as well. I would suggest to go check it out and give it a follow if you want to be updated on future releases, etc.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TeamV]Team V Developer Page[/url]

[h1]Almost There[/h1]
I am making solid progress however regarding the rest of Chapter 4 - Part One. I hope to release it within the next two weeks, so it might pop up at any time within that time period. I know everyone has been eagerly waiting for the next installment and I'm working very hard on getting it done! 

I do think you guys will love it and it'll add so much more depth to the story and the characters. Chapter 4 - Part Two should also be released no to long after that so just bare with me a little longer.

I hope you'll enjoy the new content however short it might be. 

Take care and have fun!!!
[b]Joure & Team V[/b]

notes.title: STARDROP - Chapter 4 Update And More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/fae43187663c8106f5a9a661f9150f540fe63660.png[/img]

[h1]Kept You Waiting, Huh?[/h1]
I know you all have been waiting for some news, so today I wanted to take some time and share a bunch of stuff. It'll be a lengthy post where I go over the latest developments and go into detail about what to expect over the next couple of months.

For the past 2+ years I have been looking at this splash screen while booting up the editor. Everyday I start the editor up I stare at it and it always feels like coming home. It's kind of weird that not too long from now I might not see it as much as I do now. What I'm saying is that I'm reaching the end of development and not too long from now I won't be looking at that image as much as I do now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/04c04b769ffceb7e93b40bc03ddb018a4b18415a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Chapter 4 (Part One)[/h1]
Initially I planned to have five chapters to wrap up the story but while working on chapter 4 I realized that cutting the story up into two chapters would distort the flow of the narrative. I felt that both chapters would be too short in my opinion as well. As the story is progressing at the moment I feel that heading straight towards the ending is the best way to go forward.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/111fe753b2b41c5281b60cd13274673a35d17436.jpg[/img]

This means that chapter 4 as a whole will be quite long. Not insanely long, but a proper solid chunk of gameplay. I will release chapter 4 in two parts however. Both parts will cover a good chunk of narrative however and I think everyone is waiting for something new to play so that's also one of the reasons.

So with that said it means that the game isgetting closer and closer to wrapping up the main narrative. I have split the remaining production time into three phases.
[list]
    [*][b]Phase 1: Release Chapter 4 - Part One to the public.[/b] 
(I covered the details above)
    [*][b]Phase 2: Release Chapter 4 - Part Two to the public.[/b] 
Part two will contain the narrative's conclusion. It will also contain a nice gameplay section where I mash up as much of the existing gameplay elements and create a bit more of a challenge while keeping true to the game's overall accessible design philosophy.
    [*][b]Phase 3: Polish.[/b] 
Phase 3 will have me going back and forth into different levels and gameplay mechanics and brush out as many bugs as possible while doing a final pass on all the levels. This may vary from re-doing some of the inner mechanics or adding more detail, fixing up grammar mistakes and things like that. This means that everyone will be able to experience the full game and provide feedback so that I may adjust or add/remove whatever is in the game's best interest. I will also add two more sections to the ship that the player will be able to access at a certain point before the end-game portion. So hopefully everyone who has already finished the game may find a very good reason to go re-play your favorite chapter(s) to see what they missed. The chapter selection is there to make sure you'll be able to do just that. I will also deal with adding in the final rewards regarding our backers that also made this game a possibility from our old Kickstarter campaign.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/72ef08b9c1d32881a76c1c5f9adb4458844d55a7.jpg[/img]

[h1]The STARDROP Community (And What It did For Me)[/h1]
This community is something else. When I got the game on Steam I was very, very weary about the kinds of communities that I have seen here on the platform. But it has been the exact contrary and I'm blessed with amazing individuals who have been incredibly supportive.

As some of you know my PC broke down after my trip. I was getting by using my NUC but I was saving money to get me an eGPU and thanks to a community member who donated to this cause I was able to get one much sooner than I planned. An incredible huge thank you to Cybrviper for me to be able to get a Mantiz Venuz which is currently rocking my Galax Geforce GTX 1060 - White Edition. Thanks to having the eGPU case I suddenly have a better working station than my old PC. It has helped speed up development in technical terms so I am incredibly appreciative of the support.

[i]Behold my current setup[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/740d7677e02d3ee717f9ae47055ce631bc218bd6.jpg[/img]

The development of STARDROP has been the biggest struggle in my life. This sounds negative and I have to admit that I don't know if I can go through a development cycle like this again. It all depends how well the game will be received once it goes out of Early Access and if I can sustain myself through it to work on a new title and also add new stuff to the base game (Which I still want to do).

I also learned that just being myself and be as open as possible towards everyone is the best thing any developer can do. I never liked the PR speak that most developers use or try to emulate and while I have to keep my tone a certain way and use proper wording etc, I can be myself. 

It has taken me longer than I planned to get to this stage in development but I believe it's all for the better. I was able to take my time to truly flesh out the story, think about level design. Tweak certain elements, suddenly come up with a new spin or a new game mechanic so I am happy I was allowed to go this route. 

I think it's interesting to note that I'm more of an old school game dev. I grew up with the Atari, NES, SNES all the way to the gamecube PS2 era and beyond. As well as the early FPS games like Duke 3D, Quake and Half-Life and it has shaped a lot of how I view games today. I always try to stay up to date but to be honest I'm not the biggest fan of current day trends in most games. I'll be pushing 40 in a couple of years and I'm late to the whole game developer thing. I've been modding since 2007, worked on Contagion as a level designer and now I'm at the helm of my own game. I love doing this however and I want to keep doing this. I have a bunch of ideas that I would love to bring to life. Games and stories that will have a lot in common with STARDROP in some ways yet be completely different in others. Whatever happens in the future I wanted to thank you all for at least allowing me to get this far. I'm excited to start wrapping up the story and I believe the ending is gonna be worth it.

[h1]How You Can Help[/h1]
I would like to ask for your help too, one more time. I added a new support page on our main website where you can find ways to contact myself or the team if you need help or just want to chat about the game, or life. I also listed ways where you can support us in various ways. I added these in there because over time I've received a number of people wanting to help so I decided that having a dedicated page would be the best option.
[url=https://www.stardropgame.com/support]STARDROP - Support Page[/url]

[h1]Sensi[/h1]
I wanted to also take some time to inform you all that Sensi has not been able to help me with play testing. I don't want to disclose too much of his private information but he has had to deal with an illness that doctors cannot find the cause of. He's been dealing with it when he joined but he was okay. Last year around December it seemed to worsen and he hasn't been able to even sit behind his PC ever since. He's been the number one supporter ever since the early alpha stages and not having him around has been very, very noticeable. He's the one guy who would always bring the positive side of everything. And in this day and age where so much negativity exists he was such an awesome person to hang out with. I still email with him once in a while but it's tough for him to even write an email. I've kept him on the team and will continue to do so for when he will return. I will stay optimistic and hope they will be able to figure out what's wrong with him and properly deal with his illness.

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
I can't say when exactly Chapter 4 - Part One will be released but it should not be too long from now. I'm currently waiting for new recordings so I can add them in. I've already started work on some of the levels for part two so I also plan to not take that long to get part two out as well. I think the polish phase might take some time as I want to get that done right. Obviously I will continue to fix/polish,whatever beyond the final release. If there's an issue that I might have overlooked I will fix it. As I said many times before I also want to add some more post release content in the form of SRO Missions and I have some neat ideas for some of these. So that's it for now I hope this news post was at least informative and I can't wait to finally share some new concrete gameplay stuff. ;)

I have also written down the final ending scene and I will be working on that too. That way I will have that all done while I finish up the rest of the game. This should make everything a lot easier from there on out, knowing that I have the ending properly executed and done with, leaving me with some room to tweak where needed.

That is all.

Thank you,
[b]Joure & Team V[/b]

notes.title: Aryn Got Married !!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/073dd64c3dd3df26faf472673b1bb46078c5ad74.jpg[/img]

[h1]Committing To A Sacred Bond[/h1]
Last Saturday Aryn Rozelle (who has been starring as Aryn Vance, the main protagonist of STARDROP) got married. I sadly wasn't able to attend due to how far apart we live. Ever since she took the part, she and all the others that are a part of the project, have been a blessing to work with. I was ecstatic when I learned she was going to get married to the love of her life, Alvin and they finally have joined so many others before them in this sacred bond of matrimony. I can speak from experience when I say only a few can be so lucky.

The funny thing is, however, that little over a week ago I asked her when the big day was and she told me it was next Saturday. It was late and I was like "Oh wow, that's so awesome I wish you all the best!" and I went to bed, as it was like 4 or 5 in the morning.

The next day I woke up and was like O_o. Hold on, next Saturday is the 14th of April... You see, I got married myself 6 years ago. It's pretty insane that out of all the days she could've chosen, she picked the exact same date as my own. I held out notifying her about this, as I didn't want her to feel like her day would be any less special. I know her well enough that this wouldn't be the case, but it was more of a matter of courtesy if anything else.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/064cae10bf781ce7f779839d3bb29b71e8ea91ac.jpg[/img]

[h1]Chapter 4 Progress[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/4f81f1982309debfcad942371d606aabfc804cdd.png[/img]

I'm incredibly excited for where the new chapter is headed. I've made and am still in the middle of adding in a few more alterations to the original story. In essence nothing has changed, what I usually do is add smaller details on top of what I already planned out and I'm still making some key decisions regarding these smaller details.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/b84c6f6e128c9cf3a8e5ffda8ad5949b93c0ef87.png[/img]

But there's already some proper progress and I think the new levels attain the level of quality I have been honing for quite some time. I'm also happy to report that even as I'm not able to work as I used to, I can still work in a solid manner and I haven't experienced any real changes in pace. which was a little bit of a concern.

I might also be able to get me a proper eGPU case very soon!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/212994f133aaf4812a463887ff89bd68c2a7373b.png[/img]

[h1]We're On Discord[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/fuW4b7t][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/b262d480289c960ba6cabd58d9ecd5a50ebc0d46.png[/img][/url]
I've set up a Discord server for quite some time now but I never really mentioned it. I wanted to make up for that fact and bring it to your attention right here. 

I'm online pretty much whenever I'mat my PC. I'm usually working so I don't initiate much chats, however I do drop some WIP screens on there before I show them in an update and of course I'm always there if anyone has questions or a problem. It's the easiest way to get ion touch with me and the other team members. Aryn and Robert, for instance, are in there. :)

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
And that wraps up this update. Things are going steady but I can't really estimate a release date just yet. The rate development is going it shouldn't be too long but I hope this update has shown some nice progress and I can't wait to get the chapter done and share it with all of you guys.

Please take care and I'll report back once I have something to, well, report.

Sincerely,
[b]Joure & TeamV[/b]

notes.title: STARDROP Update March 28, 2018
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Everyone[/h1]
It's been a while since the last update and I've been wanting to post something for a while now but a lot has been going on so I'll do my best to recap what has happened the past few months.

[h1]What's The New Update About?[/h1]
So a new update came out, is it chapter 4? Nope, sorry. I've updated a number of the older levels, adding new objects and small events which should add more stuff to discover while exploring.

Most of these contain smaller details that are meant to add more depth to the universe. Some Easter eggs and other things to discover as I mentioned above.

[h1]A Break[/h1]
As I mentioned in the previous news post I took a break. After working on the game for so long it started to take a toll on me and the opportunity came up for me and my family to go back to Holland where my mom and brother lives and Spain where my dad resides these days.

I haven't seen them for about 4 years at that point so I had to go. I stayed there for about three months and it was something we really needed. On top of that my mom and dad haven't seen my daughter as well. The last time they saw her she was only one year old.

I tried to work on my laptop but it wasn't up to the task. I did some prototyping for chapter 4 and it's paying off. I wanted to do something a tad different from what you've guys been doing since the start of the game while making it work due to the ending of chapter 3 and I think you'll like it. It's nothing drastic and it won't last for too long but that's all I want to say about that.

[h1]So, Chapter 4?[/h1]
It's coming. When I got back I was met with a PC that wouldn't work anymore. It would boot up for a bit and then it would blue-screen on me. I tried several fixes but nothing worked. It seems my motherboard just gave up.

With no money to replace my desktop PC (The game makes me able to survive but not much beyond that, plus the whole trip was exhausting my wallet as well (I have no regrets) but there was a blessing.

Someone at Intel reached out to the winners of the Level Up Contest, us included, and they sent me a NUC Skull Canyon. The overall specs blew my old PC out of the water, except for the GPU. It's good enough for me to continue work and this truly saved my life regarding being able to actually continue work on STARDROP. Because I'm paranoid when it comes to data I luckily backed up pretty much all the important work files on several HDD's including my external one, so I was able to pick right up where I left off.

If it wasn't for Intel I would have a really hard time trying to work on my laptop. I am currently saving up some cash to get a eGPU case so I can use my Galax Geforce 1060 GPU which should fix my graphical woes.

On top of that one of my homies, Dec Doyle from Digital CyberCherries stepped in and set up a SVN server to host my project files, so that was an incredible weight off my shoulders.

So while I don't have that much to show just yet I am finally back into action with STARDROP and in full dev mode once again. I have a lot more to announce soon but will have to wait until it's all settled and official.

Well, I have a new screenshot to show of one of the new areas I'm currently working on.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/1d03a3106022dedf9a9ee821aa3c1d48a1a06d29.png[/img]

[h1]Sorry[/h1]
Lastly before I go I want to say sorry for the lack of updates and perhaps giving the impression the game might be abandoned or something. This will never happen. I have too big a stake in this to give up. The game, story and everything means too much to me. A lot of myself is in this so I hope this should reassure anyone who might be in doubt.

So I hope this cleared up some confusions etc, and also sorry if anyone thought this was a chapter update. I'll do my best to get that done ASAP. 

Again thank you all for your support. A few new let's plays popped up and have been enjoying them quite a great deal.

So, I'll stop right here and get back to work. I have a lot of cool stuff planned and I really want, no ,need to get the game finished.

So please have some more patience and thank you for understanding and all your support for allowing me to get this far. :)

Sincerely,
[b]Joure & TeamV[/b]

notes.title: STARDROP - December Update and Merry Christmas.
notes.content:
[h1]Merry Christmas.[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/9a96c97477a604cec57e3509eba031796658a8ba.png[/img]

So, initially I planned to do a full public content update however as I am currently away from home, my laptop seems to have issues packaging the game for 32 Bit. I really wanted to share something around Christmas so I figured that I will release this update under our public developer branch.

If you want to play the updated game then make sure you set the game to:  Public Dev Branch. You can read how to opt into the public dev branch [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=954273686]HERE[/url]

So yeah, time for another content update, sort of. I'll move the update to the public branch when I'm sure there aren't any issues. This means that the base game / default public branch will remain unchanged for now.

The reason for this update, well, while I was working on the new chapter I also went back and went through chapter one and two and basically replaced / updated and added content. I have and will continue to alter early game content and see what I can add to it that helps build the game's universe.

I also didn't want Christmas and New Year's pass by without having anything to show for it, so here you go. While it's not a new chapter I do hope it's something some of you will enjoy. :)

[h1]New Content[/h1]
While in general the changes aren't incredibly significant and in one or two cases not yet finished I wanted to put this out and see what the reactions are.

I added a number of easter egss regarding my kitty game as well as expanding on things that were already there. For instance I always wanted to have a cat on board the ship, a very big nod to Alien but it also adds a little bit of character to the game. So I want to introduce to you: Rascal. A small kitten that you'll find in a few areas throughout the game. :)

[i]Little Rascal[/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/569b16c2cb72fadab6f73b1ace5378b17639410f.jpg[/img]

I also added an NPC that doesn't do very much except looking at Aryn if she comes into his view. I guess we can call him, Mike, the security guard. He's stationed at the STARDOCKS and he's there make the game feel just a tad less lonely.

[i]Hi Mike, or is it Ted? Maybe it's Luke, oh well, he's a friendly fella and very loyal to his duty !!![/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/4da1aafa6b1a5d4dbb3fe439450afa06e0c37449.jpg[/img]

I also went through Deck one on board the SD-01 and I added some more stuff to Aryn's apartment. You might even miss some of the changes because they're simply meant to add more detail and depth to the areas. 

I will continue to add more little things like these throughout development and most likely before chapter 4 is released. Oh, and you can also check out the revamped  UI of computer interfaces. I have a ton of stuff planned for the final chapters I just need time to get it all done.

[i]Purdy?[/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/663955930df5e19bce8bce731846ef91ef83eaf8.jpg[/img]

All these changes should be LIVE right now. So those who have been looking for an excuse to replay the game, this might be a good time but keep in mind, more new stuff will be added over time. ;)

[b]Joure & Team V[/b]

[i]P.S. I also fixed the fruit bowl. I know it was driving some of you bananas....[/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/bbb1ba1a0f92bf6f778aa74449beee55207cccde.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Don't Worry, We're Still Alive !!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/2caf539de2db905b26c1d8cb2111c05a33c798dc.png[/img]

[h1]What Am I Looking At?[/h1]
Hi everyone. So it's really time for me to post another update. I have quite a lot to say and I can hope that you guys can understand where I'm coming from.

So the image above is from "Play with Gilbert". A newly released game made by myself, on my own. After I finished chapter three I was ready, or so I thought, to dive into chapter four but fatigued started t settle in.

I didn't notice it at first and I was trying to work on updating the computer interfaces and trying to fix the scrollbar issue. I still haven;t found a solution yet btw. So yeah, I simply couldn't think straight. I knew what I wanted to do but it was difficult to focus. You see, I've been working on STARDROP pretty much non-stop since 2015 and while I have taken one or two small breaks I always kept going and I think it reached a boiling point so I decided to just take a few steps back and just do something else for a bit.

So I turned to a personal project I was fiddling around with, which was a small little game for my daughter to play with. And while I was playing around with some new ideas my wife basically asked me, why don't you turn this into a game you can put on steam?

And it made sense to me. It's a small project I already had some good work done on it and I haven't seen that many children's games on Steam either. I figured I could take some time off from STARDROP, hone my skills in UE4 and try some new things. Things that have helped a great deal. I am now able to fix the HUD issue regarding different screen resolutions.

I also figured I could really use some another revenue stream. STARDROP's been doing fine for a small relatively unknown exploration game and it's kept my head above the water but as you can understand I want to make this the best game I can and not go under while doing it.

Lastly I just needed the break and I have had a lot of fun making this silly little kitty game. My daughter's now basically addicted to it I certainly did not expect her to love it so much. She now plays it every night before bed time and she's stil not bored.

[h1]What Does This Mean For STARDROP?[/h1]
Well, basically I'm done with Play with Gilbert. There's a few issues I want to iron out but I managed to finish this thing a little over a month's worth of effort. 

I had to share all this info because I owe it to all of you to at least know what's going on and that I haven't ran away or something like that or if someone comes across my kitty game thinking, hey wait a minute why is this new game released and STARDROP isn't? STARDROP is the main project the big one for me, and Play with Gilbert is a small little game I made for my daughter. the two games cannot be compared in terms of scope and complexity.

And now I feel re-energized and am so ready to get back to STARDROP. My focus will be on getting localization working again and then I'll be off finishing the last two (maybe three?, idk yet) chapters. After that I will go and deal with the smaller bugs.

I'll also attempt to fix the scrollbar issues but since it's an engine feature related problem (somehow the hist detection gets messed up if you arrange widget elements in a certain way) and I'll need more time to figure out a setup that works.

So, my sincere apologies for the down-time. I can only hope you guys can understand but the most important thing is that I haven't left the project (NEVER) or anything. I'm merely a human and I guess I just reached a limit. But I feel refreshed like mad and I'm so ready to finish the story.

So while I don't have much to show other then PwG (Play with Gilbert) I do want to share the new look of the computer interfaces.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/703a799ec7f548d76d934f48b5e79ebeb814214a.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26803372/df830a6c970652ca32021c278b76c76c49e79cb7.png[/img]

So yeah, that's it for now. I'll make sure the next update won't tale as long but  I still have a lot of work ahead of me. 

Take care everyone and for those curious you can find my little kitty game over here:
 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/740040/Play_with_Gilbert/]Play with Gilbert on Steam[/url]
